simple.meaning: שׂוּשׂ (sûws) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to be bright , i.e. cheerful.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 27 times across Deuteronomy, Job, Psalms, Isaiah, Jeremiah, and 3 more, beginning at Deuteronomy 28:63. Its contexts include family, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שׂוּשׂ (H7797).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: שׂוּשׂ (sûws) / H7797 is traced through Deuteronomy 28:63, Deuteronomy 30:9, Job 3:22, Job 39:21 as a generated source-based concept entry.
